item.title: Weed-Out 480SL Glyphosate Herbicide
item.description: ## Product Overview & Key Benefits Weed-Out 480SL Glyphosate Herbicide (5 litres) Clearing a plot, fence line, compound or farm before planting by hand takes days and costs a lot in labour. Weed-Out 480SL is a non-selective, systemic glyphosate herbicide that is absorbed through the leaves and travels down to the roots, so grasses and broadleaf weeds die instead of regrowing. The 5-litre pack suits farmers, estate caretakers and contractors who clear land often. KEY BENEFITS - Systemic action kills the roots, which means less regrowth than slashing or hoeing - Controls annual and perennial grasses and broadleaf weeds, including tough couch grass - Saves labour on land preparation, zero-tillage planting, fence lines, paths and compounds - Economical: 5 L makes 16 to 25 knapsack loads depending on the weed - Rain-free period is short, so you can spray on the next dry morning TECHNICAL SPECS - Active ingredient: Glyphosate 480 g/L - Formulation: Soluble liquid (SL) - Type: Non-selective, post-emergence, systemic herbicide - Pack: 5 litres MIXING AND APPLICATION DOSAGE (per 20 L knapsack) - Young broadleaf weeds and annual grasses: 200 ml (5 L pack makes 25 knapsacks) - Perennial grasses such as couch grass: 300 ml (5 L pack makes about 16 knapsacks) At about 4 L per hectare in 200 L of water (200 ml per 20 L), one 5 L pack treats roughly 1 hectare. Always confirm the rate on your pack's label. 1. Use clean water. Half-fill the knapsack, add Weed-Out, then top up to 20 L and shake. 2. Spray actively growing weeds until the leaves are wet but not dripping. 3. Expect yellowing within a few days and root die-off soon after. 4. Avoid spraying if rain is expected within 4 to 6 hours. ## Safety, Storage & Handling Guidelines It kills any green plant it touches, so shield crops and avoid drift in wind. Keep away from water sources. Wear gloves, overalls and a face mask. Rinse the sprayer very thoroughly afterwards, or keep a separate sprayer for herbicides. WHAT'S IN THE BOX 1 × Weed-Out 480SL Glyphosate Herbicide (5 litres) This is a pest-control or agricultural chemical product. Use it only for the crop, pest, site and application method expressly authorised on the current Kenya-approved product label. Read the full label before opening or use. Follow the label exactly for personal protective equipment, dilution, application, ventilation, re-entry period, pre-harvest interval, environmental restrictions and any other precautions. Do not guess a dose, mix it with another product, or use it on food, animals, people or surfaces unless the label specifically permits that use. Keep the original container tightly closed and locked away from children, unauthorised persons and animals, and separate from food, drink and animal feed. Prevent spills and contamination of drains, wells, streams and other water sources. Do not eat, drink or smoke while handling; wash hands and exposed skin after handling. Never reuse an empty pesticide container; follow the label and approved local hazardous-waste collection or disposal instructions. In case of suspected poisoning or significant exposure, seek urgent medical attention and show the product label. Kenya PCPB poison information hotlines listed in its labelling guidance: 0800 720 021 or 0800 730 030. ## Delivery across Kenya & Nairobi Pickup Pay by M-Pesa. Delivery to all 47 counties, or pick up at The Sarit Centre, Westlands, Nairobi. Shop Weed-Out 480SL Glyphosate Herbicide in Kenya at Stermont Arcade.

item.description:
## Product Overview & Key Benefits Total 20L Knapsack Sprayer 4.5Bar (20 Litre) A good chemical is wasted if your sprayer drips, clogs or gives uneven coverage. The Total 20L Knapsack Sprayer (THSPP42002) carries a full 20 litre tank on your back, builds pressure up to 4.5 bar with the hand lever, and lets you switch the nozzle from a tight jet to a fine mist. It suits crop spraying, weed control, livestock-house disinfection and pest control around the home. KEY BENEFITS - 20 litre tank covers more ground per fill, with fewer refill trips - Adjustable nozzle: jet for reach, fine mist for even leaf coverage - Y-shaped trigger with a fibreglass lance that is light and corrosion-resistant - Light at about 2.6 kg, so it is comfortable to carry - Compatible with the insecticides, herbicides and disinfectants in our store WHERE YOU CAN USE IT - Crop protection sprays on vegetables, fruits and field crops - Weed control in fields and around buildings - Disinfecting poultry houses, livestock sheds and farm premises - Pest control sprays around the home and compound The larger tank is especially useful on bigger plots, where stopping often to refill wastes time and breaks your rhythm. MIXING AND APPLICATION GUIDE (20 L TANK) 1. Fill the tank about half full with clean water. 2. Add the measured chemical, then top up to the 20 L mark and shake well. 3. Pump to a steady working pressure. Do not exceed 4.5 bar. 4. Calibrate once: spray 20 L over a measured plot so you know how much ground one tank covers. Always follow the label of the chemical you are using for the dose, the timing and the re-entry period. CARE After each use, empty the tank, rinse it and spray clean water through the hose and lance. Keep a separate sprayer for herbicides if you can, since glyphosate residue can damage crops later. Check the nozzle and seals regularly, and store the sprayer in a shaded, dry place. ## Safety, Storage & Handling Guidelines Wear gloves, a mask, overalls and boots whenever you spray, and never use the tank for drinking water. Keep chemicals and the sprayer away from children. Its small size makes it handy for kitchen gardens, flower beds, nurseries, greenhouse corners, small poultry or livestock houses and spot treatments where a large knapsack sprayer would be too much. The tank needs air space to build pressure, so fill it only to the top mark. Q: How do I keep the nozzle from blocking? Rinse the tank and nozzle with clean water after every use so that residue does not dry inside. ## How to use Fill the tank to the level you need, using the marks on the side, and add your product as directed on its label. item.description: ## Product Overview & Key Benefits The 150W laptop charger adapter for ASUS, model reference A17-150P1A, is listed for users who need a replacement power adapter with a stated output of 19.5V and 7.7A. This listing is intended to help shoppers in Kenya find the specified 150W ASUS-compatible adapter, while encouraging buyers to verify the model details before ordering. A laptop adapter converts mains electricity into the regulated DC power required by a computer. The adapter's job is to provide the correct voltage and sufficient current for the laptop during normal operation and charging. The stated 19.5V output and 7.7A current correspond to a nominal 150W power rating. These figures are important when comparing replacement adapters because a unit with the wrong voltage or inadequate power capacity may fail to operate correctly or may cause damage. A replacement adapter should not be forced into a laptop socket. Stop using a power supply if its cable is frayed, its casing is cracked, it becomes unusually hot, or it produces a burning smell, buzzing or intermittent power. For safe everyday use, connect the adapter to a suitable mains outlet and keep its ventilation openings unobstructed. Avoid covering the power brick with bedding or other materials that trap heat. Keep the adapter and its cable away from liquids, excessive moisture and sharp edges. Disconnect it by holding the plug rather than pulling the cable. Do not open or attempt to repair the power adapter yourself; internal components can retain hazardous electrical energy even after disconnection. If the adapter, cable or connector is damaged, discontinue use and arrange a suitable replacement. When comparing laptop chargers online, look beyond the wattage alone. Confirm the output voltage, current, connector, polarity and the exact laptop model. A higher wattage rating by itself does not establish compatibility, and a physically similar connector may have a different electrical specification. This is particularly important for laptops used for office work, study, business operations and travel, where an unreliable power supply can interrupt important tasks. item.title: Amaze Fridge and Freezer Guard with Extension
item.description:
## Product Overview & Key Benefits Buy the Amaze Fridge and Freezer Guard with a 6-way extension socket online in Kenya. Power cuts, sudden returns of electricity and low voltage are some of the most common reasons fridge compressors fail. This guard sits between your wall socket and your fridge or freezer, watches the supply, and cuts the power when it is unsafe so your appliance is not damaged. How it works: the guard has three indicator lights marked OFF, WAIT and ON. When the supply is unsafe it disconnects the appliance. When power returns, the guard waits for a short delay before switching back on, which gives the compressor time to settle. This protects against the damaging quick restart that often happens when electricity comes back after an outage. A bypass button lets you override the guard if you need to. The bundle also includes an Amaze 6-way extension socket with a long white cable and a UK-style plug, so you can power your TV, decoder, phone chargers and other small devices from a single wall point. The sockets are clearly spaced, and the cable is long enough to reach across most rooms. Who needs it: any household or small business with a fridge, freezer, water dispenser or display cooler. In areas where voltage drops or blackouts are common, a guard is a small cost compared with replacing a compressor or losing a freezer full of food, milk or drinks. Pack size: 1 Amaze fridge and freezer guard plus 1 Amaze 6-way extension socket with cable. Colour: white with blue label. Plug type: UK three-pin. Please check the rating printed on the guard against your appliance before you buy, and use the guard for refrigeration appliances as shown on its label. Installation is simple: plug the guard into the wall, plug your fridge into the guard, and wait for the ON light. No tools needed. Order today, choose pickup or delivery to your county, and pay with M-Pesa at checkout. **Checking electrical protection equipment**

item.title: Bazooka 18EC Insecticide (1 Litre)
item.description: ## Product Overview & Key Benefits Bazooka 18EC Insecticide (1 Litre) Greenlife Bazooka 18EC is a broad-spectrum miticide and insecticide containing abamectin 18 g/L. It controls spider mites and leaf miners on French beans, tomatoes and other crops, where mites multiply fastest in hot, dry weather. KEY ## Technical Specifications & Pack Details & FEATURES - Active ingredient: Abamectin 18 g/L - Target: Spider mites and leaf miners on French beans, tomatoes and other crops - Formulation: Emulsifiable concentrate (EC) - Application settings: Agricultural: French bean and tomato growers and other crops MIXING & APPLICATION INSTRUCTIONS 1. Dilution rate: use the dose and water volume printed on the manufacturer's label for your crop and growth stage. 2. Application method: Half-fill the tank with water, add the measured product, top up and agitate. Spray in calm weather, early morning or late afternoon, with good coverage on both sides of the leaf. 3. Coverage: depends on the dose and spray volume on the label. Available in 1 Litre. 4. Scout regularly, checking the underside of leaves for mites and mines, and start spraying when pests first show up. 5. Rotate with products from other chemical groups and keep to the number of sprays on the label, because mites can become resistant quickly. ## Safety, Storage & Handling Guidelines & RE-ENTRY PRECAUTIONS - Wear gloves, a mask, goggles, overalls and boots when mixing and spraying. - Keep people, children and animals out of the sprayed area until the spray has dried, and follow the re-entry and pre-harvest intervals on the label. - Keep spray and rinse water away from streams, ponds and wells. Store in the original closed container, cool, dry and locked, away from food and feed. This is a pest-control or agricultural chemical product. Use it only for the crop, pest, site and application method expressly authorised on the current Kenya-approved product label. Read the full label before opening or use. Follow the label exactly for personal protective equipment, dilution, application, ventilation, re-entry period, pre-harvest interval, environmental restrictions and any other precautions. Do not guess a dose, mix it with another product, or use it on food, animals, people or surfaces unless the label specifically permits that use. Keep the original container tightly closed and locked away from children, unauthorised persons and animals, and separate from food, drink and animal feed. Prevent spills and contamination of drains, wells, streams and other water sources. Do not eat, drink or smoke while handling; wash hands and exposed skin after handling. Never reuse an empty pesticide container; follow the label and approved local hazardous-waste collection or disposal instructions. In case of suspected poisoning or significant exposure, seek urgent medical attention and show the product label. item.title: BioDistinction Extra 700SC Copper Fertilizer
item.description: ## Product Overview & Key Benefits Greenlife BioDistinction Extra 700SC Copper Fertilizer (1 Litre) Greenlife BioDistinction Extra 700SC is a liquid chelated copper suspension concentrate fertilizer. It contains copper oxychloride 700 g/L, which is 400 g/L metallic copper equivalent, and it corrects and prevents copper deficiency in vegetables, fruit, cereals and ornamentals. It is supplied in a 1 litre pack. - Liquid chelated copper fertilizer in suspension concentrate (SC) form - Copper oxychloride 700 g/L (400 g/L metallic copper equivalent) - Corrects and prevents copper deficiency - For vegetables, fruit, cereals and ornamentals - 1 litre pack - Greenlife brand WHY COPPER MATTERS Copper is a trace element that plants need in small amounts. It plays a part in enzyme activity, in the formation of chlorophyll and in flowering, pollen formation and grain filling. When copper is short, plants can show stunted growth, pale or twisted young leaves, poor flowering and lower yields. Cereals are especially sensitive, and deficiencies are more common in sandy, peaty and very high-organic soils. ## Safety, Storage & Handling Guidelines Read the label before use. Wear gloves, a mask, goggles and protective clothing when mixing and spraying, and wash well afterwards. Keep away from children, pets, food and water. Copper compounds can be harmful to fish and aquatic life, so keep spray and rinse water out of streams, ponds and drains. Store in the original closed bottle in a cool, dry place away from food and feed. Shake well before use. This is a pest-control or agricultural chemical product. item.title: E-POS 80mm Thermal Receipt Printer
item.description: ## Product Overview & Key Benefits E-POS 80MM THERMAL RECEIPT PRINTER IN KENYA The E-POS 80mm Thermal Receipt Printer is a point-of-sale printing device for businesses that need to produce clear transaction receipts at a checkout or service counter. It is intended for use with a compatible POS system and suitable 80mm thermal paper. Thermal receipt printing uses heat-sensitive paper, so the printer can produce text without a conventional ink cartridge or toner. This makes it a practical option for shops and service businesses that print customer receipts throughout the working day. A PRACTICAL PRINTER FOR BUSY COUNTERS A receipt printer is an important part of a point-of-sale workflow. After a sale is recorded in compatible POS software, the system can send the transaction details to the printer so the customer receives a printed record. Depending on the software and configuration, receipts may show items purchased, quantities, prices, totals, taxes, payment details and the business information configured in the POS system. The exact receipt layout is controlled by the software, not by the printer alone. The 80mm paper format provides a wider receipt area than smaller receipt formats. This can be useful where a business needs room for longer item descriptions, several line items or additional transaction information. Confirm the supported paper width and roll dimensions against the actual unit and the paper you intend to buy before ordering. HOW THERMAL RECEIPT PRINTING WORKS Direct thermal printers create an image by applying heat to specially coated thermal paper. Because the printing process does not use ink cartridges, businesses do not need to purchase ink or toner for ordinary receipt printing. The paper itself is the consumable. Store thermal rolls in a cool, dry place away from direct sunlight, excess heat and friction, which can affect print quality or cause receipts to darken. For consistent results, load the roll in the direction indicated by the printer's paper guide, keep the paper path clear and use rolls that meet the printer's stated width and diameter limits. If a receipt prints blank, check that the thermal paper is loaded with its coated side facing the print head. Follow the manufacturer's instructions when opening the cover or clearing a paper jam. WHERE IT CAN BE USED An 80mm thermal receipt printer may suit retail shops, supermarkets, mini-markets, pharmacies, restaurants, cafés, salons, repair counters, ticket desks and other businesses that use compatible point-of-sale software. It can support routine checkout operations by giving customers a printed record and helping staff maintain a consistent transaction process. The printer is a peripheral device; it does not independently manage stock, calculate sales or process card and mobile-money payments. Those functions depend on the connected POS software and payment equipment. CHECK COMPATIBILITY BEFORE PURCHASE Before buying, confirm the connection type supported by the exact E-POS model, such as USB, Ethernet, serial or wireless connectivity. Do not assume that every connection option is included. Check operating-system support, driver availability and compatibility with your POS application. If the printer is intended for a cash drawer, confirm that the unit has the required cash-drawer port and that the drawer and software use a compatible interface. Also verify the power adapter, plug type, paper-roll dimensions and any cables or accessories included in the package. SETUP AND EVERYDAY CARE Avoid placing liquids, dust or loose objects near the paper feed. Switch off the unit before cleaning or inspecting internal parts, and use only the cleaning method recommended by the manufacturer. Do not scrape the thermal print head with sharp objects. item.description: ## Product Overview & Key Benefits Grain-Save Dust (500 g) Grain-Save Dust is a permethrin-based protectant for stored maize and beans against weevils and other storage pests. It is mixed into dry grain at the rate printed on the label and comes in a 500 g pack suited to farmers and households storing grain. - Permethrin-based dust - Protects stored maize and beans - Works against weevils and other storage pests - Mixed into dry grain at the label rate - 500 g pack - Delivered to all 47 counties ## Technical Specifications & Pack Details - Product: Grain-Save Dust - Active ingredient: permethrin (strength on the label) - Formulation: dust - Use: grain protectant for stored maize and beans - Pack size: 500 g - Rate: as printed on the manufacturer's label ## Where & How to Use in Kenya After harvest, weevils can hollow out kernels, leave dust and holes, lower germination and make grain unfit for food or sale. Treating grain as it goes into storage protects the work you put into the crop and keeps seed and food grain in good condition for longer. ## Safety, Storage & Handling Guidelines Read the label before use. Wear a mask, gloves and protective clothing when mixing, and avoid breathing the dust. Follow the label's waiting period before using treated grain, and do not feed treated grain to animals unless the label allows it. Permethrin is very toxic to fish, so never rinse containers or equipment into streams, ponds or drains. Keep the pack closed in a cool, dry, locked place away from food and feed. Q: Can I add it to grain that was already treated? No. Using two protectants on the same grain can leave too much residue. If you are not sure whether your grain has been treated, do not add more. Q: Can I feed treated grain to animals? Not unless the label allows it. item.title: Chariot 500 SC Fungicide 100ml
item.description: Chariot 500 SC Fungicide 100ml in Kenya **Product identity and verified registration** Stermont Arcade lists Chariot 500 SC Fungicide 100ml in the 100 ml pack. This page identifies the trade name, formulation and pack size so buyers can compare the product before ordering. PCPB lists CHARIOT 500 SC as PCPB(CR)1084 with carbendazim 500 g/L. Registered crop uses include rice blast; botrytis on roses; angular leaf spot and botrytis on French beans; and early blight on tomatoes. The register lists tomato PHI 5 days and French-bean PHI 9 days; confirm all restrictions on the current label. Check the trade name, strength, registration details, batch number, seal and expiry date on the delivered container. If the label differs from this listing, pause and ask the seller or registration holder to clarify. **Intended purpose and product selection** This product is associated with only the crop and disease uses listed by PCPB and permitted by the current label. Correct selection begins by identifying the actual need and confirming that the label permits the proposed use. Do not select a product solely because its name sounds familiar. Similar trade names may have different strengths, formulations, target species, crops or pests. Confirm the exact pack and current label before opening the container. **Pack size and formulation** The 100 ml size is the exact variant represented on this page. Pack size indicates the quantity supplied; it does not establish a treatment area, number of animals, number of applications or dose. Tablets, oral drenches, suspension concentrates and emulsifiable concentrates have different handling requirements. Do not dilute, split, combine or transfer contents unless the approved label expressly instructs you to do so. item.title: Jambo Clean Foliar Fertilizer
item.description: Greenlife Jambo Clean is described as a foliar fertilizer intended to help remove honeydew and sooty mould while supplying nutrients. Its stated analysis is total nitrogen 10.0% (urea 8.5% and ammoniacal 1.5%) and water-soluble phosphorus pentoxide (P2O5) 8.2%. Honeydew is a sugary residue associated with sap-feeding insects; sooty mould can grow on it and coat leaf surfaces. Cleaning affected foliage does not itself remove the insects that produced the honeydew, so monitor for the underlying pest and manage it separately using an appropriate label-approved approach. This listing is for the 1 litre pack. ## Crop Nutrition and Product Selection A foliar fertilizer or biostimulant is one part of a complete crop-management programme. It does not replace soil testing, basal or top-dressing fertilizer, irrigation, drainage or pest management. Identify the crop, growth stage and problem before choosing a product. Weak growth, pale leaves, poor flowering or uneven fruit development can have several causes, including nutrient imbalance, water stress, root problems, soil pH, pests or disease. If the cause is uncertain, seek advice from a qualified agronomist or agricultural extension officer. ## Choosing the Right Pack in Kenya This Stermont Arcade listing identifies the product and pack size for like-for-like comparison. Check the trade name, formulation, volume and label before checkout. Different nutrient formulations are not interchangeable: a high-phosphorus product is not the same as a high-potassium or balanced feed. Choose a quantity according to the area you intend to manage and the manufacturer's directions. A larger container may suit a bigger operation, while a smaller pack may suit a nursery, kitchen garden or limited trial. Do not increase concentration or application frequency to use a pack faster. ## Label-Led Application Read the complete label on the actual container. Confirm the guaranteed analysis, crops or growing situations listed, application method, dilution, timing, frequency, compatibility and precautions. Follow the manufacturer's directions for the exact product. This page does not create a universal dose or promise suitability for every crop. Do not mix a foliar feed, biostimulant, pesticide or adjuvant in one tank unless the label or a qualified adviser confirms compatibility. If the label is missing, damaged or differs from the listing, pause and ask for clarification. ## Practical Crop Management Plan nutrient applications alongside regular field scouting and good agronomy. Keep records of the crop, planting date, soil or leaf test results where available, products used and observed response. Apply only when the crop need and label instructions support it. Avoid spraying in intense heat or when wind could carry spray away; follow the label for weather restrictions. Use clean equipment and measure with suitable tools. Maintain equipment as directed and prevent wash water from reaching drains, streams, ponds or irrigation sources. ## Safe Handling and Storage Use the protective clothing and gloves specified on the label. Avoid contact with eyes and skin and avoid breathing mist or vapour. Keep products away from children, pets, livestock, food, animal feed and drinking water. Do not eat, drink or smoke while handling; wash hands after use. Store tightly closed in the original labelled container, under the conditions stated by the manufacturer. Never transfer it into an unmarked bottle or reuse an empty container. Manage spills, leftover product and packaging according to the label and local guidance. If accidental exposure or irritation occurs, follow the label's first-aid instructions and seek medical advice where needed. ## Order from Stermont Arcade Stermont Arcade serves farmers, gardeners and agrovet customers in Nairobi and across Kenya. item.description: ## Product Overview & Key Benefits Kerol Disinfectant Fluid (1 Litre) Kerol Disinfectant Fluid has a Rideal-Walker coefficient of 18 to 20 and is a powerful disinfectant and insect repellent for livestock houses, poultry houses and domestic use. Promax 20EC is a propoxur-based, odourless insecticide concentrate that you dilute and spray straight into those hiding places. It also tackles cockroaches (mende), fleas, ants and houseflies, so one 1 litre bottle covers a house, hostel, hotel room or office. - Odourless formulation suited to bedrooms and other indoor spaces (let surfaces dry fully) - Residual action on treated surfaces, so pests that crawl across later are still affected - Multi-pest: bed bugs, cockroaches, fleas, ants and houseflies - Concentrated: 25 ml makes 1 litre of ready-to-spray liquid - Works with any hand-pump or knapsack sprayer ## Technical Specifications & Pack Details - Product: Promax 20EC Insecticide - Active ingredient: Propoxur 20% w/v (carbamate insecticide) - Formulation: Emulsifiable concentrate (EC) - Use: Household and public-health crawling-insect control - Mode of action: blocks nerve signal transmission, causing paralysis - Pack size: 1 litre ## Where & How to Use in Kenya Most homes need only a small amount of spray, so a concentrate goes a long way: one 1 litre bottle makes 40 litres of ready-to-spray liquid. Bed bugs, cockroaches, fleas, ants and houseflies are the main targets, and the residual film means that pests which crawl across a dry surface later are still affected. MIXING RATES (FROM THE PRODUCT LABEL) - 1 litre hand sprayer: 25 ml Promax 20EC, topped up with water to 1 litre - 5 litre garden sprayer: 125 ml, topped up to 5 litres - 20 litre knapsack: 500 ml, topped up to 20 litres - Most homes need only 1 to 5 litres; the knapsack rate is for hotels, hostels and large premises - Always confirm the rate on your pack's label before mixing ## Safety, Storage & Handling Guidelines Wear gloves and wash your hands after use. Read the label before you begin, and keep the bottle out of reach of children. Keep the bottle closed in a cool, dry, locked place, away from food. Use this product only for its intended purpose and follow the complete manufacturer instructions. If the item is a pesticide or chemical, the current Kenya-approved product label takes precedence: follow its authorised use, PPE, application, ventilation, re-entry, storage, first-aid and disposal directions exactly. Do not improvise chemical mixtures or application rates. Keep products and active traps or devices away from children, pets, food and animal feed. For professional fumigation or restricted-use treatments, use appropriately trained and authorised pest-management personnel. In case of suspected chemical poisoning or significant exposure, seek urgent medical attention and show the product label; PCPB poison information hotlines listed in its labelling guidance are 0800 720 021 and 0800 730 030. ## Delivery across Kenya & Nairobi Pickup Order Promax 20EC Insecticide online, pay by M-Pesa and get delivery to all 47 counties, or pick up at The Sarit Centre, Westlands, Nairobi. Questions? WhatsApp +254 789 514 060. ## Frequently Asked Questions Q: What is Promax 20EC used for? It is an odourless insecticide concentrate for bed bugs, cockroaches, fleas, ants and houseflies in homes, hostels, hotels and offices. Q: What is the active ingredient? Propoxur at 20% w/v, a carbamate insecticide in an emulsifiable concentrate (EC) formulation. Q: How do I mix it? 25 ml topped up with water to 1 litre in a hand sprayer, 125 ml to 5 litres, or 500 ml to 20 litres. Always confirm the rate on your pack's label. Q: When should I treat bed bugs again? Bed bug eggs can hatch later, so inspect after about two weeks and treat again if needed. ## How to use Half-fill the sprayer with clean water, add Promax, top up and shake well. Spray mattress seams, bed frames, headboards, skirting boards, cracks, behind sockets and furniture joints. Wet surfaces lightly; do not soak them. Bed bug eggs can hatch…

item.title: Rootex 6 Rooting Hormone (50g)
item.description: ## Product Overview & Key Benefits Rootex 6 Rooting Hormone (50 g) Rootex 6 is a rooting hormone powder that helps cuttings of roses, carnations and other ornamentals form strong, healthy roots. Nurseries, flower farms and home gardeners use it for faster, more even rooting and a higher success rate. KEY ## Technical Specifications & Pack Details & FEATURES - Composition: See the product label - Target: Rooting of cuttings: roses, carnations and other ornamentals - Formulation: Powder - Application settings: Nurseries, flower farms and home gardeners MIXING & APPLICATION INSTRUCTIONS 1. Dilution rate: Used as a powder dip: no mixing with water is needed. Pour a small amount into a separate container for dipping, not into the main tub, to avoid contaminating the rest. 2. Application method: Take a healthy cutting with a clean, sharp knife or secateurs. Dip the cut end into the powder, tap off any extra and plant it straight away into a clean, well-drained rooting medium. 3. Coverage: The number of cuttings one pack treats depends on how many you dip; the label gives the quantity. Available in 50 g. 4. Water lightly and keep the cuttings in a warm, shaded and humid place until roots form. 5. Use clean tools and trays, choose healthy cuttings, keep the medium moist but not waterlogged and protect cuttings from direct hot sun until they have rooted. ## Safety, Storage & Handling Guidelines , HANDLING & - Wear gloves and avoid contact with skin and eyes; wash your hands after handling. - Keep out of reach of children, pets and livestock, and away from food and feed. - Store tightly closed in the original pack, in a cool, dry place away from direct sunlight. item.title: Tecamin Max Foliar Fertilizer (1L)
item.description: AgriTecno Tecamin Max is listed as a plant-based biostimulant containing amino acids, vitamins and oligosaccharides. Product information describes it as supporting nutrient uptake and helping plants manage periods of heat, dry weather, nutrient stress and transplant shock. The listing identifies vegetables, fruits, flowers and ornamentals as relevant crop groups. It is a biostimulant to use alongside a sound nutrition and irrigation programme, not a replacement for ordinary fertilizer. This record is for the 1 litre pack. Check the current label for crop suitability, rate, stage and timing. ## Crop Nutrition and Product Selection A foliar fertilizer or biostimulant is one part of a complete crop-management programme. It does not replace soil testing, basal or top-dressing fertilizer, irrigation, drainage or pest management. Identify the crop, growth stage and problem before choosing a product. Weak growth, pale leaves, poor flowering or uneven fruit development can have several causes, including nutrient imbalance, water stress, root problems, soil pH, pests or disease. If the cause is uncertain, seek advice from a qualified agronomist or agricultural extension officer. ## Choosing the Right Pack in Kenya This Stermont Arcade listing identifies the product and pack size for like-for-like comparison. Check the trade name, formulation, volume and label before checkout. Different nutrient formulations are not interchangeable: a high-phosphorus product is not the same as a high-potassium or balanced feed. Choose a quantity according to the area you intend to manage and the manufacturer's directions. A larger container may suit a bigger operation, while a smaller pack may suit a nursery, kitchen garden or limited trial. Do not increase concentration or application frequency to use a pack faster. ## Label-Led Application Read the complete label on the actual container. Confirm the guaranteed analysis, crops or growing situations listed, application method, dilution, timing, frequency, compatibility and precautions. Follow the manufacturer's directions for the exact product. This page does not create a universal dose or promise suitability for every crop. Do not mix a foliar feed, biostimulant, pesticide or adjuvant in one tank unless the label or a qualified adviser confirms compatibility. If the label is missing, damaged or differs from the listing, pause and ask for clarification. ## Practical Crop Management Plan nutrient applications alongside regular field scouting and good agronomy. Keep records of the crop, planting date, soil or leaf test results where available, products used and observed response. Apply only when the crop need and label instructions support it. Avoid spraying in intense heat or when wind could carry spray away; follow the label for weather restrictions. Use clean equipment and measure with suitable tools. Maintain equipment as directed and prevent wash water from reaching drains, streams, ponds or irrigation sources. ## Safe Handling and Storage Use the protective clothing and gloves specified on the label. Avoid contact with eyes and skin and avoid breathing mist or vapour. Keep products away from children, pets, livestock, food, animal feed and drinking water. Do not eat, drink or smoke while handling; wash hands after use. Store tightly closed in the original labelled container, under the conditions stated by the manufacturer. Never transfer it into an unmarked bottle or reuse an empty container. Manage spills, leftover product and packaging according to the label and local guidance. If accidental exposure or irritation occurs, follow the label's first-aid instructions and seek medical advice where needed. ## Order from Stermont Arcade Stermont Arcade serves farmers, gardeners and agrovet customers in Nairobi and across Kenya. Walk-in customers are welcome at Sarit Centre, Westlands, daily from 8:00 AM to 8:00 PM. Confirm availability and the exact pack on WhatsApp before visiting. M-Pesa checkout is…

For houseflies, inspect waste areas and possible breeding sources. Reduce clutter, vacuum or clean appropriate surfaces, seal practical entry gaps and remove food waste. For bedbugs, avoid moving potentially infested bedding or furniture between rooms. For cockroaches, remove crumbs, grease and standing water and store food in closed containers. For houseflies, manage refuse and sanitation conditions that can support breeding. item.title: NPK Falcon 23:23:0 Fertilizer 50kg
item.description: NPK Falcon 23:23:0 Fertilizer 50kg – Price in Kenya NPK Falcon 23:23:0 is a compound fertilizer listed in a 50kg bag for crop nutrition programmes. The grade identifies a fertilizer with nitrogen and phosphate nutrients; the zero in the third position indicates that potassium is not declared as part of this grade. The Kenyan retail reference checked for the 50kg bag was KSh 5,200. Confirm current price and availability before purchase because retailer listings can change. What the 23:23:0 grade means Fertilizer grades express the guaranteed nutrient analysis in a standardized order. For an NPK 23:23:0 product, the grade communicates nitrogen and phosphate content, while the third value indicates no declared potassium in the grade. Buyers should read the bag label to confirm the exact guaranteed analysis, nutrient form, manufacturer and any additional declared nutrients. Do not assume that all products called NPK have the same composition; grades such as 17:17:17, 23:23:0 and 25:5:5 are materially different products. Where it may fit in a crop programme A nitrogen-and-phosphate fertilizer may be selected where a soil test or crop recommendation identifies a need for these nutrients. Nitrogen supports vegetative growth and is involved in chlorophyll and protein formation. Phosphorus contributes to energy transfer and root development. Whether this particular grade is appropriate depends on the crop, soil nutrient status, planting stage and the availability of potassium and other nutrients. It is not a universal fertilizer for every soil or crop. Choosing the 50kg bag The 50kg pack is aimed at growers, farm groups, commercial farms and agrovet businesses buying a full bag for planned use. Check the bag weight, product grade and label before comparing prices. A product with a different nutrient ratio or pack size should not be treated as an exact price equivalent. If you are comparing NPK Falcon 23:23:0 with DAP, MAP, TSP or balanced NPK grades, compare the actual nutrient analysis and recommended crop use rather than relying only on the product names. Application and agronomic guidance The appropriate rate and timing must be based on the crop recommendation, soil test and manufacturer's label. Soil type, rainfall, irrigation, previous fertilizer applications and yield target can all change the amount required. Do not apply a generic rate taken from another crop or region. Avoid placing fertilizer in direct contact with seed or young roots unless the label permits that method. Use suitable measuring tools and apply evenly according to the recommended placement. Store and handle fertilizer to prevent moisture exposure and nutrient loss. Avoid spreading during strong winds or before heavy rain. Keep granules away from streams, wells, drainage channels and other water sources. Do not over-apply; excessive nutrients can harm crops, waste money and contribute to runoff. If the field has a known potassium deficiency, seek advice on whether a separate potassium source is needed because this 23:23:0 grade does not declare potassium. Mechanical mouse traps may be considered for enclosed locations where signs of mouse activity have been identified, such as storage rooms, kitchens, cupboards, shops and stock areas. Look for droppings, gnaw marks, damaged packaging and gaps around doors or service openings. These signs can help identify likely travel routes. Place traps only in suitable locations and follow the manufacturer's setup instructions. Avoid placing them where people, pets, cleaning equipment or routine stock handling could disturb them.

Integrated rodent prevention

Trapping works best as part of a wider prevention routine. Store food and animal feed in closed, rodent-resistant containers, clean up crumbs and spills, manage waste in covered bins, and remove clutter that can provide hiding places. Inspect doors, vents, pipe openings and wall gaps for access points and arrange suitable repairs. In commercial food-handling or storage premises, include rodent checks in routine cleaning and pest-monitoring records. These steps help reduce conditions that attract rodents and make ongoing activity easier to identify.

Handling, hygiene and storage

Although this is a non-chemical trap, it still needs careful handling. Keep unused traps clean and dry and store them away from food, animal feed and children. Follow the instructions supplied with the product when setting or resetting the mechanism. Avoid touching a captured rodent directly; use suitable protective equipment and follow public-health guidance for hygienic removal and disposal. item.description:

This catalogue record is for the exact quantity shown in its title: 4 pieces. It is a mechanical capture product, not a rodenticide pellet, wax bait, bait station or spring-loaded snap trap. How an adhesive glue board works

A glue board is a passive trapping device that uses an adhesive surface to retain a rodent that contacts it. It is different from poison bait and does not provide a locked bait compartment. The retailer's online listing does not fully specify board dimensions, adhesive formulation, folding arrangement or accessories. Those details are therefore not guessed in this description. Follow the exact manufacturer's instructions for preparation, placement, checking and disposal. Do not modify the board or add substances unless the label explicitly directs it.

Placement and non-target protection

Use a stable, dry and sheltered location, following the manufacturer's directions for this exact product. Keep the board inaccessible to children, pets, poultry and other non-target animals. Do not put it on food-preparation surfaces, inside food containers, on public walkways or anywhere people may step on it. Avoid wet areas and locations where sweeping or routine cleaning could dislodge it. In shops, restaurants, food stores and warehouses, record trap locations in the site's pest-management plan and ensure relevant staff know where devices have been placed.

Inspection, hygiene and disposal

Inspect the device at the frequency required by the manufacturer and the premises' hygiene procedures. Do not leave a captured animal unattended. Wear suitable protective gloves when handling a used board, avoid direct contact with rodents or contaminated material, and wash hands thoroughly afterwards. Follow the package directions and local waste-handling requirements for disposal. Do not wash or reuse a disposable adhesive board unless the manufacturer explicitly states that it is reusable. Replace a damaged, wet or contaminated board according to its instructions.

Combine trapping with prevention

Trapping is only one part of rodent management. Store grains, animal feed and dry food in closed containers, clean spills promptly, empty bins regularly and remove clutter that can provide hiding or nesting places. Inspect doors, vents, pipe entries and wall openings, then seal suitable gaps with materials appropriate for the building. Keep stored materials organised and reduce sheltered access routes where practical. If rodent activity continues, is widespread or affects food handling, consult a qualified pest-management professional about an integrated control plan.

item.title: Rodilon Wax Blocks 1kg
item.description:
Rodilon Wax Blocks 1kg – Rodent Control for Kenyan Premises

Rodilon Wax Blocks 1kg is a larger pack of ready-to-use rodenticide bait for buyers managing rat and mouse activity around farms, stores, warehouses and other premises. The Kenyan PCPB public-health register lists Rodilon Wax Blocks under registration PCPB(CR)0827 and identifies difethialone at 1.25 g/kg as the active ingredient. The register describes the product as a rodenticide for control of rats and mice around domestic environs. The 1kg pack is intended for buyers with a defined rodent-management requirement and secure storage.

Product Identity

Rodilon is supplied as wax blocks rather than loose grain or liquid bait. The block format is designed for placement in suitable bait stations and for use in locations where a durable bait format is appropriate. Check the active ingredient and registration details against the actual pack before purchase. The Kenyan register identifies Bayer Crop Science AG and Bayer Environmental Science SA in the manufacturer information and lists Highchem Marketing Ltd as distributor in the local registration entry.

Do not confuse Rodilon with similarly named rodenticides, other active ingredients or different pack sizes. The 1kg pack is distinct from the smaller 10g product already sold in the Stermont catalogue. Check the label, registration number, batch information, expiry date and seal before accepting delivery. This product is not food, feed or a household cleaning product and must be kept separate from consumables.

Where the 1kg Pack May Fit

A larger pack may suit pest-management programmes covering several bait stations or a larger site, provided the user is authorised and the label permits the intended setting. Typical buyers may include farms, storage facilities, commercial premises and pest-management operators who need a documented monitoring programme. A large pack is not automatically appropriate for every household. Choose a quantity that can be stored securely and used within the manufacturer’s stated shelf life.

Rodent control should begin with inspection. Look for droppings, gnaw marks, damaged food packaging, tracks and likely entry points. Remove accessible food waste, keep feed in sealed containers, close gaps where practical and reduce clutter that provides nesting cover. Bait should not replace sanitation, proofing or monitoring. The goal is to reduce rodent access and food sources while following the label and applicable local rules.

Safe Placement and Handling

Rodenticides can harm people, pets, livestock and non-target wildlife if handled or placed carelessly. Use this product only as directed on the current Kenyan label. Place bait in suitable tamper-resistant bait stations wherever required or recommended, and secure stations so they cannot be moved or opened by children, pets or other animals. Never scatter bait where it can be reached by children, domestic animals, poultry or wildlife. Keep it away from food, feed and drinking water. Wear the protective equipment specified on the label when handling bait or servicing stations. Wash hands after handling, keep a record of each station and inspect it at the interval stated on the label. Collect and dispose of dead rodents and leftover bait according to label instructions. Do not feed poisoned rodents to pets or wildlife. Store unused blocks in the original sealed container in a locked, dry place away from food, feed, medicines and water sources.

Choosing a Rodent-Control Programme

Rodent activity differs by site. A home pantry, poultry unit, grain store and warehouse do not have identical risks or access patterns. Consider the area to be monitored, the number of bait stations, the presence of children and animals, and whether a professional pest-control operator should manage the programme. Follow…

Termidor 96SC is a professional termiticide supplied in a 1-litre pack for structural termite-management work. The Kenyan PCPB register lists Termidor 96SC under registration PCPB(CR)1572 and identifies fipronil at 96 g/L as the active ingredient. The registered use is for control of termites in buildings and the construction industry. The 1L pack is intended for professional pest-control and construction-related buyers who have a verified requirement and can follow the approved label and handling restrictions.

Product Identity and Formulation

Termidor 96SC is a suspension concentrate formulation containing fipronil 96 g/L. It is not the same product as a general household aerosol, a rodent bait or a ready-to-use ant gel. The Kenyan registration identifies it as a termiticide for structural termite control. BASF is identified as the manufacturer in the registration information. Check the registration number, exact concentration, pack size, batch and expiry details on the physical container before use.

The supplier describes the product as a non-repellent termiticide for building and construction work. A treatment barrier is only appropriate when the site is inspected and the product is used according to the approved label. Termite species, construction type, soil conditions, existing infestation and the building layout can affect the treatment plan. Do not rely on generic online dilution advice where it differs from the current Kenyan product label.

Who Should Buy the 1L Pack

The 1L size is a professional-use pack for pest-control operators, contractors and institutional buyers who need the exact registered formulation for a planned job. It may suit a verified structural treatment requirement, but it is not a recommendation for untrained household application. The Kenyan supplier listing describes it as a termiticide for buildings and construction and notes professional pest-control operator use. Buyers should confirm that they or their contractor are appropriately qualified and authorised before ordering.

Before purchasing, ask the service provider to inspect the building and explain the proposed treatment scope. Confirm whether the job is pre-construction or post-construction, which areas will be treated, how people and pets will be protected, and how treated areas will be managed during and after application. Select pack size based on the professional’s approved job plan, not by guessing the amount required from floor area alone.

Professional Application and Safety

Use Termidor 96SC only in accordance with the current Kenyan label and applicable PCPB requirements. The product should be handled and applied by qualified pest-control operators following the label’s protective equipment, mixing, placement, re-entry and disposal instructions. Keep residents, children, pets, livestock and unauthorised workers away from mixing and treatment areas. Do not apply near food, feed, wells, drains or water bodies unless the label expressly allows the treatment and all precautions are met. Do not invent or copy a dilution rate from another Termidor concentration or another country’s label. Concentrations and approved uses can differ between formulations. The operator should read the exact pack label, use calibrated equipment, prevent spills and spray drift, and keep a record of the treatment. Store the product upright in its original sealed container in a locked chemical store away from food, feed, medicines and water. Manage empty containers and unused product according to the label and local requirements.

item.description:
Goodknight Multi Insect Killer Aerosol 600ml – Household Pest Control

Goodknight Multi Insect Killer Aerosol 600ml is a ready-to-use household aerosol for managing common flying and crawling insect pests. The Kenyan PCPB public-health register lists Goodknight Multi Insect Killer Aerosol under registration PCPB(CR)1404 and identifies imiprothrin 0.05%, cypermethrin 0.1% and prallethrin 0.09% as its active ingredients. The 600ml can is a larger household format for buyers who need an aerosol pack rather than a concentrate that must be mixed or applied with specialist equipment.

Product Identity

This listing is specifically for the 600ml Goodknight aerosol. The Kenyan marketplace listing identifies the brand, pack size and in-stock status, while the PCPB public-health register provides the registered product identity and active-ingredient information. Check the can label and registration details before use. Do not confuse this product with Goodknight liquid electric vaporizer refills, mosquito mats or other Goodknight formulations; they are different products with different application methods.

The aerosol format is designed for direct use according to the instructions printed on the can. It is not a concentrate for dilution and should not be poured into a sprayer or mixed with other pesticides. Use it only for the target pests and settings stated on the current label. If a pest problem is recurring or widespread, identify the source before repeatedly spraying.

When to Choose an Aerosol

An aerosol may be useful for a targeted household pest-control need where the label permits direct application. Buyers may consider this format when they need a ready-to-use can and do not want to prepare a spray mixture. Identify the insect first. A flying insect problem, a cockroach hiding in a crack and a persistent bedbug infestation may require different control methods. An aerosol should not be assumed to solve every infestation or replace professional inspection where pests are recurring.

The 600ml size offers more contents than small household cans and may suit a larger home or a buyer who uses aerosol products periodically. Check the can’s net contents and condition when receiving it. Do not select a large can simply because it contains more product; buy only what can be stored safely and used within the stated shelf life. Keep the original can so all label information remains available.

Safe Use and Storage

Read the full label before spraying. Aerosol insecticides are pressurised products and must be kept away from heat, sparks, flames and hot surfaces. Do not puncture or burn the can, even when empty. Avoid breathing the spray mist and do not spray directly onto people, pets, food, food utensils, drinking water, aquariums or food-preparation surfaces. Keep children and animals away during application and until the label’s re-entry instructions have been met. Use only in the manner and location described on the can. Provide the ventilation stated on the label and avoid spraying near ignition sources. Do not use in a confined space unless the label expressly allows it. Store upright in a cool, dry and secure location away from direct sunlight and temperatures above the label’s limit. Do not transfer the contents to another container. If exposure occurs, follow the first-aid information on the can and seek medical advice with the label available.

Practical Household Pest Management

Good household pest control begins with reducing the conditions that attract insects. Keep food sealed, clean crumbs and spills, empty waste bins, repair leaking taps, remove standing water and close gaps around doors or windows where practical. Use screens and other physical barriers to reduce entry. For cockroaches, remove accessible food and water and inspect likely harbourages. For mosquitoes,…

The 1L pack is aimed at agricultural users with a planned, label-compliant use and suitable secure storage.

Crop Use and Buying Considerations

Atom 2.5EC belongs in a crop-protection programme where the target pest and crop are included on the approved label. The PCPB register specifically identifies thrips and aphids on French beans and roses, plus caterpillars and aphids on roses. Do not extend those uses to other crops, pests or settings without confirming that they are authorised on the current label. Crop stage, pest pressure, pre-harvest interval and re-entry interval can affect whether a treatment is appropriate.

The 1L size is a bulk format compared with smaller packs listed in the Kenyan market. It may suit a farm or professional buyer with a clear requirement and appropriate storage facilities. A larger pack is not automatically the best-value choice if only a small quantity is needed before expiry. Compare pack size, label, seller availability and the amount required for the planned treatment.

Safe and Responsible Use

Use Atom 2.5EC only in accordance with the current Kenyan product label and applicable pesticide rules. Wear the personal protective equipment specified on the label during measuring, mixing and application. Avoid contact with skin and eyes and do not inhale spray mist. Keep children, pets, livestock and unauthorised people away from mixing and application areas. Do not eat, drink or smoke while handling the product, and wash hands and exposed skin after work. Prevent spray drift and avoid contaminating ponds, streams, drains, wells, animal drinking water and food. Respect the label’s re-entry and pre-harvest intervals. Never invent a dosage or increase concentration to compensate for poor pest identification. If uncertain, consult a registered agro-dealer or qualified agronomist before use.

Integrated Crop Pest Management

Insecticide use should be supported by crop scouting, sanitation, removal of heavily infested plant material where appropriate, monitoring and good field hygiene. Identify the pest before selecting a product. Use the registered product only for the label-listed crop and pest, and follow resistance-management advice from a qualified agronomist. item.title: Econo Rat Bait Station 1pc
item.description:
Econo Rat Bait Station 1pc – Controlled Rodent Bait Placement

The Econo Rat Bait Station is a physical rodent-control accessory designed to provide a defined location for placing rodent bait as part of a managed rat-control programme. This listing is for one station. It is not a rodenticide, and the station should not be assumed to include bait unless the seller’s product details or the delivered package explicitly confirm that. Buyers should inspect the product contents and the station’s locking and placement features before use.

Why Use a Bait Station

A bait station helps keep rodent bait in a designated location instead of leaving bait loose on floors, shelves or other accessible surfaces. Controlled placement can make it easier to record where bait is located, inspect activity and reduce accidental contact by people and non-target animals. The station is an accessory for a rodent-management plan; it does not by itself eliminate rodents or replace sanitation, proofing and monitoring. For homes, shops, restaurants, stores, farms and warehouses, rodent control should start with an inspection. Look for droppings, gnaw marks, damaged food packaging, tracks and entry gaps. Remove accessible food waste, store feed in sealed containers, repair gaps where practical and reduce clutter that can provide nesting cover.

Choosing a Station for Your Site

Before buying, consider the site layout, likely rodent routes, presence of children and pets, access by livestock or wildlife, and whether the station will be used indoors or outdoors. Check the physical station’s size, entry points, anchoring options and locking mechanism before installation. Do not assume that every bait station is suitable for every bait block, paste or pellet. Confirm compatibility with the bait product and follow the bait label’s instructions. This listing is for one Econo station. If a larger property needs several monitoring points, plan the number of stations after inspection rather than buying an arbitrary quantity. Mark each station with an identifier and keep a site map or record so the person responsible can find and inspect every point.

Safe Use with Rodent Baits

Use only a registered bait appropriate for the target rodent and site. Keep bait inside the station and prevent access by children, pets, poultry, livestock and non-target wildlife. Do not place bait stations on food-preparation surfaces or near food, feed or drinking water. Secure the station so it cannot be casually moved or opened. Wear the protective equipment stated on the rodenticide label when handling bait or servicing a station. Wash hands after handling and record any bait added or removed. Collect dead rodents and dispose of leftover bait according to the bait label. Do not feed poisoned rodents to pets or wildlife. Store unused rodenticide separately in its original sealed container; a station is not a substitute for secure chemical storage.

Inspection, Maintenance and Buying Guidance

Inspect stations at intervals appropriate to the bait label and site risk. Look for movement, damage, moisture, contamination or signs that non-target animals have accessed the station. item.title: Double-Sided Yellow Sticky Flying Pest Trap
item.description: # Double-Sided Yellow Sticky Flying Pest Trap ## Product overview This yellow sticky trap uses a bright coloured surface and adhesive on both sides to catch flying insects that land on it. The Kenyan listing describes it as a pesticide-free physical trap for monitoring and capturing flying pests. It is intended for placement near areas of insect activity and can be used as part of a monitoring programme in homes, gardens, shops or growing areas. The source listing does not state a precise board dimension or pack count, so confirm the actual unit size and supplied quantity before ordering. ## Why use a double-sided trap The adhesive surfaces are exposed on both sides, allowing insects to contact the trap from more than one direction. Yellow colour can attract certain flying insects, but capture rates depend on the pest species, light, location, competing plants and the amount of insect activity. A sticky trap is a monitoring aid; it does not by itself eliminate a breeding source or guarantee control of an infestation. ## Selecting a physical pest-control product Choose a trap or barrier by identifying the pest and where it is entering or moving. A fly ribbon is intended for flying insects, a glue-book trap for rodent monitoring, and window mesh for mosquito exclusion. These products are not interchangeable. Check the room layout, likely pest routes, access for inspection and exposure to moisture or dust before deciding where to place the item. ## Site assessment and integrated pest management Inspect the area before installation. For flies, check waste bins, drains, uncovered food, animal areas and damp organic matter. For rodents, inspect gaps around doors and pipes, stored food, clutter and signs of movement along walls. For mosquitoes, check window openings, damaged screens and standing water nearby. Remove food residues, cover refuse, repair openings and reduce standing water where possible. Use traps to monitor activity and support an integrated pest-management plan rather than relying on one device to solve every source of infestation. ## Placement and inspection Follow the supplied fitting or placement instructions. Keep adhesive surfaces away from food, utensils, children, pets, customer contact and walkways. Avoid wet, dusty or windy positions that can reduce adhesion or make a trap difficult to inspect. Check products regularly and replace them when full, damaged, dirty, wet or no longer effective. For rodent traps, inspect frequently and handle any captured animal or used adhesive board with care. ## Care and responsible disposal Store unused items in their original packaging in a clean, dry place. Protect adhesive products from heat, direct sunlight and moisture. Do not burn used traps or place them where wildlife can become entangled. Seal disposable used traps before putting them into suitable waste and wash hands after handling. Clean the surrounding area and continue monitoring after replacement. If pest activity persists or spreads, arrange a site inspection by a qualified pest-management professional. ## Buying for Kenyan homes and businesses For a Nairobi apartment, restaurant, school, shop, warehouse or farm store, consider the number of rooms, likely entry points and how often the item can be inspected. A single trap may monitor one location but cannot be assumed to protect an entire building. For window screens, measure the frame and confirm the dimensions and fastening method before ordering. For adhesive traps, confirm the intended pest and the quantity supplied. ## Nairobi pickup and Kenya-wide delivery Stermont Arcade offers pickup at Sarit Centre, Westlands, Nairobi, daily from 8 AM to 8 PM. item.description: The GMLuminos Pro Glue Board Fly Catcher is a commercial flying-insect capture unit listed by a Nairobi supplier at KSh 18,000, reduced from KSh 24,000 on the page checked. The supplier describes a system that traps insects on an adhesive film at the bottom of the unit and automatically winds the film at regular intervals. The design is intended to help contain captured insects and reduce the risk of loose insect fragments contaminating surrounding areas. The supplier also describes an option to add a rear glue board to increase the capture area in higher-risk environments. The listing does not state the exact unit dimensions, room coverage, motor specification or number of consumable rolls included, so confirm these details before ordering. Why a glue-board fly catcher is different A glue-board unit captures flying insects on an adhesive surface rather than relying on an exposed high-voltage grid. The automatic film-winding feature described by the supplier is designed to move used adhesive film along at intervals, helping keep captured insects covered. This can be useful in customer-facing premises and locations where hygiene and discreet monitoring are important. The machine still needs correct placement, regular inspection and the appropriate consumables. It does not remove the need for waste control, cleaning, fly screens, door management or other integrated pest-management measures. Choosing a commercial fly-control unit Consider the number of doors, windows and waste-handling areas, the type of business, the location of food and preparation surfaces, and how frequently staff can inspect the device. In food environments, follow the site’s food-safety procedures and the trap manufacturer’s recommendations for placement. Ask whether the rear glue board is supplied or is an optional extra, and confirm the correct adhesive film or board refill before purchasing. A unit with automatic winding still requires scheduled checks to ensure that the film advances and the collection area remains clean. Site planning and monitoring Before installing equipment, review where flies enter, where waste is stored, and where staff or customers spend time. Keep a simple inspection record showing the installation location, cleaning date, lamp or adhesive replacement date, and any increase in insect activity. This helps a site manager notice changes and plan maintenance before equipment performance declines. If the infestation continues despite a correctly maintained trap, investigate doors, windows, drains, refuse areas and other sources rather than relying on the device alone. Keep records accessible for routine audits. Safety and responsible use This equipment is one part of an integrated pest-management programme. Sanitation, waste control, exclusion, drainage repairs, monitoring and correct placement remain important. Electrical insect killers contain high-voltage components and should be installed where children and unauthorised people cannot reach them. Do not touch internal grids or service a powered unit. UV lamps are not general-purpose room lighting and should not be viewed directly at close range. For pesticide fogging, use only products whose labels and the machine manual permit the intended site and equipment. Never improvise a dilution or application rate. The 3kg pack is listed for crawling-pest management, including bed bugs, ants, cockroaches, silverfish, fleas, ticks, mites, lice, spiders and beetles. Diatomaceous earth is made from the fossilised remains of microscopic aquatic organisms and works through physical contact rather than a conventional neurotoxic insecticide mechanism. This listing describes the material as food-grade; always confirm the package label and intended use before applying it. Product overview Diatomaceous earth contains naturally occurring silica. When suitable dry powder contacts an insect, fine particles can abrade the outer protective layer and absorb surface moisture. This physical action can contribute to dehydration and eventual insect death. Results depend on pests contacting the dust; it is less effective when wet or covered by debris. The 3kg pack is intended for customers who need more material than a small sachet. It may suit planned treatment of dry cracks, crevices and other appropriate areas where crawling insects travel, if permitted by the label. It does not replace pest identification, cleaning, sealing entry points or integrated pest management. Pack size and selection This listing is for one 3kg pack. Check the net weight on the delivered package. The amount needed depends on the property, pest pressure and label directions. A larger pack may suit repeated or wider-area maintenance, but a smaller pack may be more economical for a small isolated problem. Where it may be used The supplier lists bed bugs, ants, cockroaches, silverfish, fleas, ticks, mites, lice, spiders and beetles among the target pests. Diatomaceous earth is a contact material, so it only affects insects that encounter the treated dust. Use it only in dry sites allowed by the label, such as suitable cracks and crevices. Do not assume it is suitable for every surface, food-contact area, animal enclosure, mattress or outdoor location. Application and preparation First identify the pest and read the full product label. Wear the protective equipment specified on the label and avoid creating airborne dust. Apply only as directed, using a light and controlled application. Keep people and animals away from the treatment area during application and follow any label instructions about re-entry, cleaning and ventilation. Do not mix the powder with other chemicals or use it in a way that is not stated on its packaging. Before treatment, remove accessible food sources, manage waste, repair leaks and reduce clutter. For bed bugs, ants or cockroaches, combine treatment with inspection, cleaning and exclusion. For extensive or recurring infestations, seek professional pest-management advice. Safety and storage Although the seller describes this product as food-grade, that wording does not mean the dust should be inhaled, eaten or allowed to contact eyes. Fine dust can irritate the nose and airways and may irritate skin or eyes. Avoid breathing dust while opening or applying the pack. Keep it in its original labelled container, tightly closed and stored in a dry place away from children, pets, food, animal feed and water sources. Wash hands after handling and follow the product label for spill clean-up and disposal. If exposure or an adverse reaction occurs, follow the label's first-aid advice and seek appropriate medical guidance. Buying and ordering in Kenya Stermont Arcade lists the 3kg pack for customers in Kenya. The current baseline reference is a Kenyan retailer listing the same 3kg product at KSh 3,599; the Version 8 pricing rule calculates the Stermont selling price from that baseline. Confirm availability before payment. M-Pesa checkout is available, and the team can assist on WhatsApp at +254 789 514 060. item.title: Tronic 10W Insect Killer 1 Tube
item.description: The Tronic 10W Insect Killer is a compact electric insect-control unit designed for indoor spaces where flying insects are a nuisance. It uses a 10-watt UV-A tube to attract flying insects towards an electrically charged grid. The manufacturer’s product listing identifies the model as IK 7011-10 and states a coverage area of up to 100 square metres. This makes it a practical option to consider for suitable homes, small business premises and other indoor environments where a plug-in insect light is appropriate. **Product Overview** This model is listed with one 10W UV-A tube and a 2800V transformer. The UV-A wavelength is specified as 365nm. The housing is described as ABS, with a protective mesh around the high-voltage grid. The unit is designed for flexible placement: it can be wall-mounted, placed on a suitable surface or suspended where the installation allows. Its stated electrical supply is AC 220–240V, 50Hz. The supplier lists a one-year warranty. The stated coverage figure is a manufacturer specification, not a guarantee that every room will be insect-free. Actual results depend on room layout, competing light sources, insect activity, placement and maintenance. Use the unit as part of an integrated hygiene and pest-management programme rather than as a substitute for removing breeding sites, keeping doors and windows screened, and managing waste. **Where It May Be Used** Potential settings include kitchens, dining areas, small shops, reception areas, offices and other indoor locations where flying insects are a concern. Select a position that is suitable for an electrical appliance and consistent with the product instructions. In food-handling environments, place insect-control equipment so that trapped insects cannot contaminate exposed food, utensils or preparation surfaces. Follow applicable food-safety and workplace requirements. For homes and businesses in Kenya, the 10W format may be worth considering where a compact insect light is preferred. Before purchase, compare the room size and layout with the stated coverage, and check that the available mounting position has a suitable power outlet. The listed supply specification is AC 220–240V, 50Hz. **Installation and Positioning** Install the unit in accordance with the manufacturer’s instructions. Choose a stable, dry position with adequate clearance and access for cleaning and tube replacement. Avoid placing it where it can be splashed, exposed to rain, knocked over, or reached by children. Do not install it directly above exposed food or food-contact equipment. If wall-mounted or suspended, use a secure fixing appropriate to the surface and the appliance. Positioning affects performance. Avoid placing the unit next to bright competing lights if the product instructions recommend a darker location. Consider likely insect entry points and the layout of the room. Do not obstruct ventilation openings or the protective mesh. **Electrical Safety and Maintenance** This appliance contains a high-voltage insect grid. Switch off and unplug it before cleaning, moving it or carrying out maintenance. Never touch the internal grid while the unit is connected to power. Keep the appliance dry and do not use it with a damaged cable, plug, housing or protective mesh. Repairs should be handled by a qualified technician or an authorised service provider. Clean the collection area at intervals appropriate to insect activity and the manufacturer's guidance. Use a dry, suitable cleaning tool only after disconnecting the power. Do not spray water or liquid cleaners into the unit. The UV-A tube is a replaceable consumable; when its output declines or the tube fails, use a compatible replacement with the correct rating and fitting. Dispose of used tubes safely and in accordance with local waste requirements. **What Is Included and Warranty** The supplier listing identifies the Tronic IK 7011-10 as a 10W, one-tube insect killer and states a one-year warranty. item.title: Bottom Door Sealer Strip
item.description: Bottom Door Sealer Strip is a practical physical barrier for reducing gaps beneath doors. The Kenyan supplier describes this product as a door-bottom strip designed to help block drafts, dust, insects and noise. It is a non-chemical pest-exclusion accessory that can complement a wider household or premises pest-prevention plan. The product page lists the item in stock and identifies three colour options: grey, black and wood brown. Confirm the selected colour and exact dimensions with the store before ordering. Product overview A gap beneath an external door can provide a route for crawling insects, dust and outside air to enter a room. A door-bottom seal helps reduce that opening by placing a flexible barrier along the lower edge of the door. It is intended for prevention and exclusion rather than killing insects. This makes it a useful accessory for homes, shops, offices, rental units and other premises where reducing entry points is part of routine pest management. Product features and fitment The supplier describes the strip as suitable for standard doors and lists grey, black and wood-brown colour options. The listing does not provide a verified technical drawing or a precise fit range for every door type. Measure the door width, floor clearance and the shape of the bottom edge before ordering. Check that the strip will not drag excessively, prevent the door from closing, or interfere with a threshold, carpet or floor track. Ask the store to confirm the supplied dimensions and fitting method if your door has an unusual profile. Where a door seal can help A bottom seal can help reduce the passage of dust and small crawling insects through the gap beneath a door. It may also reduce drafts and some outside noise. It is a preventive accessory and should not be treated as a complete solution for an established infestation. Inspect other likely entry points such as window frames, service penetrations, damaged screens, wall cracks and gaps around pipes. Combine physical exclusion with good housekeeping, waste management and appropriate monitoring for a more complete approach. Installation and maintenance Follow the instructions supplied with the product. Check the floor surface and door clearance before fitting, and make sure the strip is aligned evenly along the bottom edge. If the product requires cutting or adjustment, measure carefully and avoid removing more material than needed. Open and close the door several times after fitting to confirm that it moves freely and that the seal remains in place. Periodically inspect the strip for wear, dirt build-up, loose sections or damage, and clean or replace it as directed by the supplier. Choosing the right size and colour The listed product page identifies three colour choices: grey, black and wood brown. Confirm the available colour before checkout because colour availability can change. Measure the door rather than estimating from a photograph. Check the height of the gap and the type of floor underneath the door. A seal that is too large may catch on the floor, while one that is too small may leave an opening. If the door is unusually wide or has a raised threshold, ask for fitment advice before purchase. Buying pest-exclusion products in Kenya When buying a door seal in Kenya, compare the product length, material, fitting method, colour and door clearance rather than relying only on the product name. Check the supplier's current product information and inspect the item on delivery. Physical barriers can help limit pest entry, but they do not replace appropriate sanitation, food storage, waste control, inspection or professional pest-management support where needed. Storage and household safety Keep unused rolls sealed in their original packaging in a cool, dry place. Keep them away from children, pets, food, animal feed and surfaces where the adhesive could cause accidental contact. Avoid touching the glue. The supplier lists the pack as 5g water-dispersible granule sachet. Its PCPB registration is PCPB(CR)1400, and the listed active ingredient is Acetamiprid 700g/kg. The registered use is: Registered crop insecticide for control of whiteflies, aphids and thrips on roses and tomatoes, whiteflies on French beans, and thrips in broccoli. WHO Class II, moderately hazardous, yellow colour band. Check the physical pack and current label before use because the label determines permitted application, rates and precautions. Formulation and intended use This product is supplied as 5g water-dispersible granule sachet. The supplier lists the 5g sachet in stock. This is a wettable granule crop-protection product; it is not a household insecticide. Observe the crop-specific label, re-entry interval and pre-harvest interval. Formulation matters: an aerosol is ready to use as packaged, while concentrates and water-dispersible granules require preparation only as directed by the label. A dust is a dry formulation. Do not substitute this product for another formulation simply because the brand or target pest appears similar.
